objective.name: sandbox.remote.state
objective.description: Wrapper outbound reflexive call toward a remote instance child context

#root.role: Emit an outbound cross-instance reflexive state read and return the remote state payload.

effects.external_route: The wrapper emits an outbound cross-instance reflexive call.

transformation_contract.morphing: A local wrapper state request becomes a remote reflexive state snapshot returned through the inter-instance path.
invariants: The wrapper emits exactly one outbound read.state reflexive call to the requested remote context.
The remote read is constrained to include only the context section.
ok is hard-coded to true by the wrapper when the outbound call itself returns.
success: On success, sandbox.remote.state returns ok, remote_status, remote_from, and remote_payload.
remote_payload contains the payload returned by the remote read.state call.
failure: The capability fails if the outbound inter-instance reflexive call cannot complete.
Missing to_context results in forwarding an empty target context to outbound routing and may therefore fail there.
notes: This is a wrapper-side remote reflexive oracle used in inter-instance state tests.
The contract intentionally surfaces the remote response envelope rather than flattening the remote payload.
